themes.name: Service and staff
themes.description: How attentive, well-paced, friendly or rude the servers, bartenders, hosts and managers were, including greetings, check-ins, order timing, and how complaints, apologies and comps were handled.

themes.name: Reservations and seating policy
themes.description: Reservation handling, walk-in and wait times, hosts refusing or delaying seating such as requiring a full party, and lost reservations.

themes.name: Prices and portion sizes
themes.description: Whether the cost of dishes, drinks and the total bill felt justified, and whether portions were small or generous relative to the price.

themes.name: Food saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Comments on whether dishes were too salty, over- or under-seasoned, bland, or well-flavored in general.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: The signature wood-fired or char-grilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including their sauce, size, preparation and freshness.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: The fried alligator appetizer with chili garlic aioli, including its texture, chewiness, taste compared to chicken and the sauce.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon
themes.description: The signature Louisiana cochon dish of pulled pork patty with cabbage, cracklins and pickled turnips or peaches, including its dryness, flavor and cracklins.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: The rabbit and dumplings entree, including how the rabbit, sauce and biscuit-like dumplings compare to expectations such as a pot pie.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: The braised or paneed pork cheek dish, including tenderness, flavor and accompaniments.

themes.name: Smoked ribs
themes.description: The smoked or grilled pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, sauce, spice and flavor.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: The macaroni and cheese casserole side, including creaminess, flavor, saltiness and whether it stood out.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: The gumbo varieties such as chicken and andouille, duck, or deviled egg gumbo, including flavor, saltiness, portion and comparison to other gumbos.

themes.name: Brisket and horseradish potato salad
themes.description: The smoked beef brisket entree and its horseradish potato salad, including tenderness, fattiness, saltiness and portion.

themes.name: Ham hock
themes.description: The smoked ham hock entree, including its dryness, smokiness, saltiness and flavor.

themes.name: Gulf fish and catfish
themes.description: The fish entrees, such as oven-roasted gulf fish, redfish, and catfish courtbouillon, including freshness, fishiness, flavor and preparation.

themes.name: Boudin and livers
themes.description: The fried boudin balls and the fried chicken or rabbit livers with pepper jelly, including flavor, texture and quality compared to elsewhere.

themes.name: Boucherie and charcuterie
themes.description: The boucherie plate, head cheese, pate, terrines and other house-cured meats, including variety, quality and value.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: The complimentary warm rolls or bread service, including their quality, butter, refills and whether they were brought to the table.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Dessert items such as pineapple upside-down cake, chocolate cake, banana cream pie, hummingbird cake and sorbets, including quality and whether dessert was offered.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Cocktails, beer, wine, bourbon and moonshine selection and quality, including drink prices and bar drinks.

themes.name: Noise and seating comfort
themes.description: How loud the dining room was, how tightly packed tables, benches and chairs were, and how that affected conversation and comfort.

themes.name: Decor and ambiance
themes.description: The look, vibe and atmosphere of the restaurant, including the decor, wood design, open kitchen, trendiness and lighting or music.

themes.name: Hype and expectations
themes.description: Comparisons of the restaurant to its reviews, awards and reputation, including whether it was overrated, a tourist trap, lived up to the hype, or compared to other New Orleans restaurants.

themes.name: Cleanliness and food safety
themes.description: Hygiene and safety concerns such as cockroaches, hair or foreign objects in food, illness after eating, dirty glassware and kitchen handling practices.

themes.name: Menu customization and dietary needs
themes.description: How well the restaurant accommodated vegetarians, allergies, substitutions, special requests and menu variety, including limited menu options.

themes.name: Bar and kitchen counter seating
themes.description: Experiences sitting at the bar or chef's counter, including the view of the kitchen and how comfortable the bar or counter seating was.
